register.reg_long_name: TLB Invalidate GPT Information by PA, All Entries, Local
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_RME is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Invalidates cached copies of GPT entries from TLBs. Details:

content.para: The invalidation applies to TLB entries containing GPT information that relates to a physical address.
The invalidation applies to all TLB entries containing GPT information.
The invalidation affects only the TLBs for the PE executing the operation.

purpose_text.para: The full set of TLB maintenance instructions that invalidate cached GPT entries is: TLBI PAALL, TLBI PAALLOS, TLBI RPALOS, and TLBI RPAOS.
These instructions have the same ordering, observability, and completion behavior as all other TLBI instructions.

attributes_text.para: TLBI PAALL is a 64-bit System instruction.

access_permission_text.para: The Rt field should be set to 0b11111. If the Rt field is not set to 0b11111, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether:

content.para: The instruction behaves as if the Rt field is set to 0b11111.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.

ps.name: TLBI
